A smallest whole blade attains equality. The finite coarea decomposition extends the infinitesimal estimate to all real signals, including zero-difference edges; Gronwall gives all-time exponential bound and exact first-order norm. The complete blade-size classification follows by integer inequalities. Independent finite checks 15006 cut profiles, 9600 random signals and 3595 Euler diagnostics passed, but the analytical argument supplies the universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural total-variation seminorm of graph heat flow controls contrast preservation. The theorem identifies the exact logarithmic norm and necessary/sufficient global contraction threshold in an infinite graph family with triangles, revealing a nontrivial smallest-blade obstruction. Balanced two-clique unions behave differently from all genuine multi-clique windmills, with an explicit optimal witness. This is a complete structural classification, not a routine finite example or mere reparametrization of known star results.
